posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-subhub 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9aba6d9a3522cfa991bd.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-subhub is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9aba6d9a3522cfa991bd.html
